content: Safe pattern for adding a NOT NULL enum column to a table with existing rows: (1) CREATE TYPE role_enum AS ENUM (...); (2) ADD COLUMN role role_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'voluntario_comum' in one ALTER TABLE (Postgres 11+ optimizes NOT NULL + non-volatile DEFAULT as a metadata-only change, no full table rewrite/lock); (3) optionally DROP DEFAULT afterward if new rows must always specify a role explicitly. Avoids the older two-step nullable-then-backfill-then-NOT-NULL dance, which is only strictly necessary pre-PG11 or when the default is a volatile expression.
